instruction: Fix `capitalize_words` so it capitalizes the first letter of each word while preserving the remaining characters. `str.capitalize()` lowercases the rest.
gold_patch:
diff --git a/textutils.py b/textutils.py
--- a/textutils.py
+++ b/textutils.py
@@ -12,7 +12,7 @@
 
 def capitalize_words(s):
     """Capitalize the first letter of each word, preserving the rest."""
-    return " ".join(w.capitalize() for w in s.split())
+    return " ".join((w[:1].upper() + w[1:] if w else w) for w in s.split())
